Namaz Akışı: Ivyabaye ku gihe c’isengesho
Iyi ngingo yongerwamwo biciye muri porogarama y’ibikorwa vyikora
Mushakisha ntizishobora kuronka uruhusha rw’igihe cose. Muyongere muvuye ku rutonde rwa plugin rwa porogarama nka Tasker, MacroDroid canke Automate.
Muyongere muhitamwo ”Namaz Akışı” ku rutonde rwa plugin rwa porogarama nka Tasker, MacroDroid canke Automate.
Mwari mwabujije iyi porogarama kwemeza amasengesho yanyu. Murashobora kuyemerera muri Namaz Akışı mu Mahitamwo > ”Porogarama zishobora kwemeza amasengesho”.

%1$s irashobora kumenya igihe igihe c’isengesho gitangura, igihe kiriko kirarangira n’igihe muri ku musigiti, igakoresha ibikorwa vyanyu vyikora. Murashobora guhindura icemezo canyu muri Namaz Akışı mu Mahitamwo > ”Porogarama zishobora kwemeza amasengesho”.

%1$s irashobora kwemeza ko isengesho ry’ubu ryasenzwe biciye ku gikorwa cikora mwashizeho. Murashobora guhindura icemezo canyu muri Namaz Akışı mu Mahitamwo > ”Porogarama zishobora kwemeza amasengesho”.
